dataset_name: India Emergency Shelters & Evacuation Points Registry
source_organization: OpenStreetMap Contributors / National Disaster Management Framework
coverage: Emergency shelters, cyclone shelters, flood relief camps, and community refuges in India
license_conditions: Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0 / Public Humanitarian Disaster Relief Records
operational_rule: CRITICAL: Presence of a shelter record does NOT confirm that the facility is currently operational or has available capacity. Operational status must remain UNKNOWN unless explicitly verified by authoritative on-ground reports. Distance is an objective spatial metric in kilometers; it is NOT a safety score.
